Interface ForwardSensitivityDeltaHedgedPortfolio.HedgeRatioProvider

Enclosing class:
ForwardSensitivityDeltaHedgedPortfolio
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface ForwardSensitivityDeltaHedgedPortfolio.HedgeRatioProvider
Provides the hedge-ratio estimator used at a rebalancing time.

The default provider delegates to ForwardSensitivities.getHedgeRatios(Map, double, Map, List, RandomVariable[], RandomVariable[], double, ReductionMethod, int). A custom provider may persist the raw pathwise gradients or replace them by externally projected gradients before delegating to ForwardSensitivities.

Author:
Christian Fries
